rationale: CO-29 timely filing denial. 837P envelope is dated 2025-10-15 (~9 months after DOS 2025-01-19), which would be late under most commercial filing limits. However, the 277CA carries received date 2025-01-27 — only 8 days post-DOS — and shares trace TRC75364521 with the October 837P. A 277CA cannot predate its 837P; one date is wrong. If a prior submission was accepted on or near 2025-01-27, that acceptance report is proof of timely filing and the CO-29 is appealable. Without that answer the disposition cannot be determined.
